proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 4312 article gives Malayalam pur̤u worm, caterpillar, maggot, grub, moth, mite; pur̤ukka to be eaten or infected by worms, putrefy, rot.. The Byari survey form pulu “earthworm” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
